Track 2: Core Concepts

E-Invoice Lifecycle

From the moment an invoice is created in your ERP to its final archiving on the buyer\'s ledger, a PEPPOL document moves through six distinct processing gates.

Step-by-Step Processing Timeline

Stage Detail

1. Author (C1)

The seller drafts the invoice in their local ERP or accounting system.

The data is typically structured as JSON or a database record.

UAE Invoice Processes (P1 - P9)

P1

Standard billing

Typical billing invoice generated for standard sales transactions.

P2

Corrective billing

Credit Note issued to correct standard invoices.

P3

Simplified billing

B2C retail billing.

P4

Deemed supply billing

Declaring tax on self-supplies or gifts.

P5

Export billing

Declaring tax-free sales to non-GCC entities.

P6

Self-billing

Buyer creates invoice on behalf of the seller.

P7

Free Trade Zone billing

Billing within designated zones.

P8

Simplified Credit Note

Corrective note for B2C invoices.

P9

Profit Margin billing

Billing under the margin scheme.
